CheckTitle: Ensure Fusion Applications Administrators Have Access Only to Fusion Applications Resources
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: OCI tenancy access (IAM policies, Fusion environment settings, Logging, Monitoring)
Description: OCI IAM policies for Fusion Applications administrator groups should grant only the fusion-applications-family resource type, with no tenancy-wide or unrelated service permissions.
Risk: Broader grants let SaaS administrators change compute, network or storage resources they do not manage.
AuditProcedure: Identity & Security > Policies: review policies for groups containing Fusion administrators.
Confirm they use fusion-applications-family and contain no 'manage all-resources' or unrelated resource types.
Confirm the Console navigation for those administrators shows only Fusion Applications.

Steps: Remove policies granting non-Fusion services to the Fusion admin group.
Use 'Allow group FusionAdmins to manage fusion-applications-family in tenancy' (and 'read' for viewers).

DefaultValue: No access until policies are created; careless scoping can grant broad tenancy permissions.
